info.name: ReadMore API
info.description:
Every endpoint and error case for the ReadMore API 

Run `npm run seed` and start the server first. Run the folders in order (or the whole collection in the Collection Runner): later requests use ids saved by earlier ones. Each request checks its expected status code.

exec: // Save the new id for later requests

item.name: Create a second author (used for "same title, different author") → 201

exec: // Save the new id for later requests

item.name: Create an author with no name → 400
Get an author with a malformed id → 400
Update an author (partial: only bio changes) → 200
Update an author to an empty name → 400

exec: // Save the new id for later requests

item.name: Create a second book for the same author → 201

exec: // Save the new id for later requests

item.name: Get a book with a malformed id → 400
Update a book (partial: only price changes) → 200
Create a book for an author that doesn't exist → 400
Move a book to an author that doesn't exist → 400
Rule 2: no duplicate titles per author (409)
Same title, same author, different case → 409
Rename a book to another of the author's titles → 409
Rule 5: search, filter, sort, pagination on GET /books
Stats for an author with books → 200
Create an author with no books → 201

exec: // Save the new id for later requests

item.name: Stats for an author with no books → 200 (zero count, nulls)
Delete an author who still has books → 409
Now the author has no books, so the delete works → 200
Delete an author with no books → 200
